about:
RxSource (NJ) Inc. was founded in 2005 in Canada and now operates from its U.S. headquarters in West Deptford, New Jersey, with additional facilities in Richmond Hill, Ontario, and Dublin, Ireland. The company began as a Canadian clinical trial supply provider and expanded internationally, opening its Irish site in 2017 and its New Jersey site in 2018 before relocating and expanding the U.S. facility in 2025.

The firm provides end-to-end clinical trial supply services to pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors, including sourcing of commercial products (comparators, co-medications, rescue medications, ancillaries), packaging and labeling under temperature-controlled conditions (ambient, refrigerated, frozen), global temperature-controlled distribution through its own facilities and a network of partner depots, Importer of Record services, and EU Qualified Person (QP) release. Its quality system is supported by a TrackWise EQMS, and the company reports 27% growth in units packaged, 103% growth in packaging runs, and 570% growth in labels printed over the prior year.

RxSource serves the global pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry, specifically clinical trial sponsors who need comparator sourcing, packaging, labeling, storage, and distribution for investigational medicinal products. Its customer base includes sponsors running trials across North America and Europe.

The company states that its patient-first mission—aiming to improve the lives of 10 million patients in 10 years—drives its culture. It differentiates itself through industry-leading timelines, flexible capacity planning, an experienced team, and a quality-first approach that goes beyond regulatory requirements.
